sql: SELECT TOP 10 COUNT(DISTINCT o.OrderId) AS totalQuotes, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN s.StatusCode = @submittedCode THEN o.OrderId END) AS submittedCount, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN s.StatusCode = @approvedCode THEN o.OrderId END) AS approvedCount, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN s.StatusCode = @canceledCode THEN o.OrderId END) AS canceledCount, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN s.StatusCode = @inReviewCode THEN o.OrderId END) AS inReviewCount, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN s.StatusCode = @expiredCode THEN o.OrderId END) AS expiredCount, MIN(o.ClassNumber) AS firstQuoteNumberAsc, MAX(o.ClassNumber) AS firstQuoteNumberDesc, MIN(o.Total) AS minTotal, MAX(o.Total) AS maxTotal FROM dbo.ZnodeOrder o INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodeCPOrderClass oc ON oc.CPOrderClassId = o.ClassId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePortal po ON po.PortalId = o.PortalId LEFT JOIN dbo.ZnodeOmsOrderState s ON s.OmsOrderStateId = o.OmsOrderStateId WHERE oc.ClassCode = @quoteClass AND po.StoreCode = @store AND (@owner IS NULL OR o.UserId = @owner) GROUP BY o.UserId, o.PortalId HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT o.OrderId) >= @minQuotes AND (@maxQuotes IS NULL OR COUNT(DISTINCT o.OrderId) <= @maxQuotes) AND (@minStatuses IS NULL OR COUNT(DISTINCT s.StatusCode) >= @minStatuses) ORDER BY MIN(o.ClassNumber)
